jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description: Our mission We're making Africa the first cashless continent. In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash. We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast. Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in... How you'll help us achieve it We are growing our product design team and looking for an experienced mobile designer to expand features on our Android and iOS apps. You will have the opportunity to make financial services more accessible and inclusive for millions of people through working with thoughtful product managers, researchers, and engineers! In this role, you'll: Work closely with product managers, user researchers, engineers, and data analysts from the start to end of a feature. Create high quality designs, interactions, and prototypes to explore ideas in service of the best solution for the project (Wave uses Figma). Craft user research plans and work directly with our user researchers to identify problems and validate solutions in user testing. Contribute to Wave's design system and component library. jobs.title: Stage: Innovative Strategic Business Design
jobs.description: Jouw ideeën. Echte uitdagingen. Zichtbare impact. Welkom bij Lab271. Ben jij een gedreven (master) student Industrial Design Engineering en op zoek naar een hands-on stage in strategic business design en innovatie, waarbij je écht het verschil kunt maken? Dan is deze kans bij Schuberg Philis iets voor jou! Bij ons werk je niet alleen aan projecten voor toonaangevende klanten zoals PostNL, NS en Heineken, maar draag je ook bij aan het innovatieve kloppend hart van onze organisatie: Lab271.  Over Schuberg Philis Bij Schuberg Philis zijn we trots op wat we doen. We zijn verantwoordelijk voor het bouwen en beheren van cruciale computersystemen voor grote bedrijven, waaronder Geldmaat, ING en de Haven van Rotterdam. Als stagiair maak je deel uit van ons innovatieteam Lab271 en krijg je de kans om jouw creativiteit en vaardigheden in te zetten om echte problemen op te lossen.  Over Lab271 Lab271 is het innovatielab waar toekomstgerichte oplossingen worden ontwikkeld voor uitdagende vraagstukken. Hier draait alles om experimenteren en het toepassen van opkomende technologieën om echte problemen aan te pakken. Je zult werken aan onderzoek, conceptontwerp, prototyping, business modelling, visualisaties en workshops voor diverse klanten. Ben je benieuwd naar wat één van je voorgangers heeft gedaan? Bekijk dan hier het verslag!  Wat ga je doen Onderzoek en analyse van complexe klantvragen. Vertalen van businessproblemen naar creatieve oplossingen. Conceptontwerp en prototyping van innovatieve producten en diensten. Faciliteren van workshops en events. Bijdragen aan de groei en innovatie van Schuberg Philis.    Wie wij zoeken Een enthousiaste en proactieve student, bij voorkeur volg je de Master Industrial Design. Affiniteit met technologie, innovatie, design en digital. Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en een “can do”-mentaliteit. Creatief denkvermogen en probleemoplossend vermogen. jobs.title: Senior Web Designer
jobs.description: Who are we? At UpGuard , we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process 100 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk. We build the Cyber Risk Posture Management (CRPM) platform that security teams actually love. By integrating security ratings, threat intel, and agentic AI, we empower organisations to stay ahead of an ever evolving attack surface. We aren’t just building another tool; we’re defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale. Where does this role fit in? Most designers ship a page and never find out its impact. Here, you'll find out every week. We're putting together a growth squad: a small team of growth marketers, developers and one designer, with one job. Work out what turns a visitor into a customer, then do more of it. You'll be that designer. You'll pitch ideas, design landing pages, page sections and sign-up flows we test, and see the results on every one. You'll work inside an established design system and help shape what gets added to it, with AI built into how you prototype and ship. About 80-90% of your time will be on the web. The rest goes to the bigger creative moments that support it, like interactive tools, launch pages and more. Those bigger moments are where we want to push. We rebuilt our brand in 2025 and we want the best website in cybersecurity. That means interactive product demos, scroll-driven stories and free tools other designers wish they'd made. What will you do? Design and ship a steady stream of website experiments: landing pages, page variants, UI modules, forms and CTAs, each built to test a clear hypothesis against a clear metric. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health. You’ll join +60 builders shipping one of Europe’s biggest consumer AI products, shaping how millions of students learn. Why Knowunity? We're building the #1 AI learning companion for 1 billion students. A future where every student on the planet can access, enjoy & benefit from the highest quality education. Since founding Knowunity straight out of high school in 2020, we've been committed to revolutionising how students learn. Millions of students already use our AI learning companion weekly. We just raised €27m - Europe’s largest education round in the past three years. The AI learning market is at an inflection point, finally enabling true personalisation at scale, and we're determined to build the first AI learning unicorn in this space. You will join an elite team of +60 hands-on builders serving 1 billion students worldwide. If we execute on our product vision, you will have built something generational that transforms education globally. This is your chance to build a generational company that shapes how an entire generation learns. Why now? Design is the single highest-leverage investment at Knowunity right now. You’ll be at the center of that shift. We’ve built a product millions of students love , powered by an engineering team that ships & learns extraordinarily fast. Now we’re going all-in on craft . The kind of UI excellence, motion design, and systematic thinking that turns a loved product into a world-class one. We just brought on a new Head of Design . jobs.description: At Parallel, we build AI agents to help healthcare facilities automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding. Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost in manual, repetitive administrative work. Legacy software hasn’t helped, it’s made things slower, more complex, and more frustrating for care teams. We believe AI agents can change that. Our technology combines Large Language Models with system-level automation to handle real work inside existing hospital tools. No integrations, no disruption. Our first agent automates coding workflows and frees up time for medical staff to focus on patients. We launched in 2024, are backed by top investors (Index, Frst, Y Combinator, Hexa, Kima Ventures, Better Angle), and we’re just getting started. The future of healthcare isn’t just digital — it’s automated. Come help us build it ! Context We’re looking for a Product Designer to join our first Designer on Parallel’s design: the app used every day by hospital coding teams, as well as the brand. You’ll work daily with Product Managers, Engineers and the Ops team. You’ll work on complex, domain-specific topics, with demanding users. Your mission Own product improvements end to end, including some product management: understand the need, frame and define the problem, prioritize, design the solution, then follow it through to production. Prototype quickly, including by coding with tools like Claude or Cursor when that’s the most efficient way. Push code to production. Contribute to branding. jobs.description: Qui sommes-nous ? N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus RH et financiers. Avec plus de 20 000 clients et 1 million d’utilisateurs dans 98 pays, notre solution N2F s’impose comme la référence sur le marché français. N2F est une solution complète de gestion des dépenses professionnelles (notes de frais, cartes corporate, factures fournisseurs), le tout dans une interface simple, intuitive et 100% connectée (app web et mobile). Nous recherchons un.e Graphiste Confirmé(e) pour faire évoluer notre identité visuelle, la faire vivre sur l'ensemble de nos supports, produits et marchés, et faire de notre site web une vitrine attractive . Tu intégreras l'équipe Communication et travailleras au quotidien avec les équipes Sales, RH, Product, la Direction ainsi qu'avec nos prestataires externes. Tu auras pour mission de : Faire évoluer notre identité visuelle sur l'ensemble de nos supports, produits et marchés, et en garantir la cohérence au quotidien. Concevoir les créations de nos campagnes marketing : publicités, réseaux sociaux, emails, lancements produits et communications clients.
